svg.title: SynthFlag maximal image-to-score execution graph
svg.desc: An uploaded image passes request validation and RGB decoding, then splits into a 224 pixel CLIP lane and a 384 pixel SigLIP lane. Two independently checkpointed experts in each family run exact patch embeddings, transformer stacks, pooling, classifier heads, float32 softmax, and unweighted arithmetic-mean fusion. A boundary note states that DINOv3 is not in the released inference path.
svg.text: FIGURE 15 · RELEASED INFERENCE · MAXIMAL EXECUTION GRAPH
One image → two vision families → four experts → one score
Solid arrows are executable runtime operations. Each expert owns a complete, independently loaded checkpoint.

g.text: is instantiated, checkpointed, or executed in the
CLIP FAMILY · EXPERTS 1 + 2 · OPENAI CLIP ViT-L/14
same architecture · independent full parameters · 304,163,586 parameters each · calls 1 then 2
SIGLIP FAMILY · EXPERTS 3 + 4 · GOOGLE SigLIP So400M PATCH14-384
same architecture · independent full parameters · 428,521,282 parameters each · calls 3 then 4
logits cast to float before softmax

svg.text: Execution order: materialize 384 then 224 batches; call CLIP 1 → CLIP 2 → SigLIP 3 → SigLIP 4; paths are logical branches, not concurrent model execution.
